shapeSummary: Worm wheel blank only: a 37.5 mm diameter, 10 mm thick disc with its axis along Z. It has a central 8 mm bore and four 4 mm through holes on a 16 mm bolt pattern. It is shifted so its bottom sits at Y=0, with X and Z centered on 0.
warnings: Teeth are not modeled. The wheel is a plain disc at the estimated outer diameter.
The 10 mm thickness is an estimate, not a stated value.
The 8 mm REX bore is modeled as round rather than hex.
The 4 mm hole diameter and 8 mm radial positions are assumed from the hub pattern.
The extra holes visible between the four modeled ones are omitted.
